== Summary ==
David's Head. [[Brian Rippetoe]] has fellow Star Trek CCG World Finalist David Bowling in a WWF-approved head lock. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
